name: csdmflow
description: Text-to-diagram for CSDM service models: write entities and relationships, get a laid-out diagram.

scripts.test: node test/smoke.js && node test/labels.js && node test/export.js
scripts.build: esbuild src/browser.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=csdmflow --minify --target=es2019 --outfile=dist/csdmflow.min.js --banner:js="/*! csdmflow | (c) 2026 Jesse Szepieniec | MIT License | https://github.com/jessems/csdmflow */"
